{{Otheruses|unidentified prisoner}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
The body of a '''prisoner''' was kept preserved in a [[Dromund Fels oubliette|Sith oubliette]] within a room filled with treasure that was located on<ref name="The Forgotten Prison">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Forgotten Prison}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="planet">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref> [[Dromund Fels]].<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Forgotten Prison" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified survey team|survey team]] discovered the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]].<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to Dromund Fels to explore the oubliette. There, the companion discovered the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] who was [[Prison/Legends|held]] in the oubliette.<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The prisoner was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill mission "The Forgotten Prison."<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" /> An earlier version of the mission was exclusive to Sith Empire&ndash;faction players and specified the survey team as an Imperial one,<ref name="TORhead">{{WebCite|url=http://www.torhead.com/crew-mission/6FSiqVI/the-forgotten-prison|text=The Forgotten Prison|work=torhead.com|archivedate=20150317013938}}</ref> though that fact was later removed from the game, as was the information regarding the mission's outcome.<ref name="The Forgotten Prison" />
